subject: Request: Academic Consortium Sponsorship — Summer Data Residency Credits
summary: External academic consortium asked for credits and a short trial extension for a 6-week summer data residency program; internal sales and education lead coordinated a one-time promotional credit plus a 3-month trial extension with monitoring and minor billing commitment.
messages:
From: Dr. Emily So <emily.so@univnorth.edu>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Summer Data Residency — request for compute credits and short trial extension

Hi Laura,

I'm leading the Summer Data Residency at Northfield University (a 6-week program pairing grad researchers with community partners). We're planning to use Redwood for model-assisted anonymization and iterative fine-tuning on synthetic datasets. The residency runs mid-September to late October.

We have modest funding and were hoping Redwood could provide: 1) a promotional credit allocation to cover model inference for student projects (estimated ~200k tokens per project, 18 projects), and 2) a short extension of the free trial window for the residency cohort so students can onboard before classes start.

I've attached a brief program proposal and a usage estimate spreadsheet that lays out per-project token assumptions. Happy to jump on a quick call this week.

Thanks,
Emily
Dr. Emily So
Assoc. Director, Data Science Residency
Northfield University

Attachment: data_residency_proposal.pdf (pdf)
Attachment: usage_estimate_Q3.xlsx (xlsx)

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: emily.so@univnorth.edu
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 10:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Fwd: Summer Data Residency — request for compute credits and short trial extension

Ben / Vivek — FYI, Dr. Emily So from Northfield reached out asking for credits + a trial extension for an academic residency beginning mid-September. Program looks high-impact (lots of student projects, community partners).

Key asks: ~3.6M tokens total across cohort if their estimate holds, plus they want the trial window to extend by ~45 days so students can complete onboarding/baseline evals.

Can we consider a one-time promotional grant (I was thinking 500k in platform credits + a 3-month extension) and require them to sign a short sponsorship terms doc? I attached their usage estimate.

If this looks reasonable I can propose terms and confirm with Emily.

-laura
Laura Bennett
Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Attachment: usage_estimate_Q3.xlsx (xlsx)

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 12 Aug 2026 14:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Summer Data Residency — request for compute credits and short trial extension

Laura — thanks for looping me in. Quick thoughts:

- The ask as-written (~3.6M tokens) is modest, but we should plan for headroom. Suggest offering 750k-1M tokens as promotional credits plus a 90-day trial extension for the student cohort.
- Require a signed basic sponsorship terms doc that limits per-account monthly spend after credits and outlines acceptable use.
- Ask them to opt into a short monitoring check-in mid-program so our EDU team can surface any abuse or unexpected cost spikes.

I attached a draft sponsorship_terms_draft.docx and my internal estimate (see usage_estimate_Q3). If we're comfortable I can approve up to 1M tokens for promo credits; anything larger needs Vivek sign-off on a small reserved commit (billing).

- Ben
Ben Carter | Education Solutions, Redwood Inference

Attachment: sponsorship_terms_draft.docx (docx)

From: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
To: ben_carter@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 11:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Summer Data Residency — request for compute credits and short trial extension

Ben / Laura — I approve up to 1M promotional token-equivalent credits for this residency program under the following conditions:

1) Sign sponsorship_terms_draft.docx (standard EDU pilot terms).
2) Northfield agrees to a modest billing commitment if they exceed credits: a $1,000/month soft cap notification, followed by required PO for continued usage.
3) We run two brief check-ins (week 2 and week 4 of residency) with their technical lead; our EDU team will help with onboarding.

Please confirm and I will route the one-time credit in billing and add a 90-day trial extension to their test accounts. This is high-signal for outreach into other universities — let's make the onboarding friction minimal.

Vivek Kulkarni
Head of Partnerships, Redwood Inference

Hi Emily — great to meet you (virtually). Update: we can sponsor your summer residency with a one-time promotional allocation of up to 1,000,000 token-equivalent credits and a 90-day trial extension for the student cohort, pending the signed sponsorship terms.

Next steps:
- I'll attach the sponsorship terms (sponsorship_terms_draft.docx) and a short onboarding checklist. Please review and return a signed copy.
- Once signed, Ben will provision the credits and my team will extend the trial window on the specified test accounts.
- We ask for two optional 15-minute check-ins (week 2 & week 4) so our EDU engineers can help troubleshoot and make sure the credits are used effectively.

If that works, can you confirm the preferred contact for account setup and a PO contact (if you anticipate exceeding the sponsored credits)? We can also schedule a quick kickoff call next week.

Thanks — excited to support this program.

Best,
Laura Bennett
Partnerships, Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
